changes in the operation of the Pao-Chia system effective North
of the Soochow Creek. I have stressed the importance of
Police co-operation in this matter.

A.C. (C45 B)
Pao Chia S.O.

IMPORTANT
D.O."C" Memo 40.
D.O."C"-Division Office
May 19, 1942.

Officer i/c H. WH KR & DR
Associate Officer i/c.

The Pao-Cha System and the Vigilance Corps, North of the Soochow
Creek, is at present supervised and controlled by the Japanese Naval
Landing Party. By arrangements already concluded the latter mentioned
authorities will shortly hand over the supervision and control of the
Pao Cha System in the area above mentioned to the Shanghai Municipal
Council.

Citizenship Certificates approved by the S.M.C. and Japanese Naval
Landing Party will be issued by the Pao Cha Divisional Office to
residents residing within their area.

I desire that officers i/c of Stations will inform all members of
their respective staffs of the administrative change in the system
referred to, and impress upon all concerned the importance of close
co-operation and assistance in this matter in the interests of the
preservation of law and order. Please ensure that all Chinese members
are thoroughly instructed on this point.

Commencing from the 20/5/42 the following Police representatives
will be seconded to the various Divisional Offices of the Pao-Cha for
instructional purposes regarding various matters pertaining to the
operation of the system.

(1) J.S.722 M.Taira,(Kashing Road)to Pao Cha 4th Division Office
Lane 211/7 East Yuhang Road. Tel. No. 51693
(2) J.S.628 T.Tsuru,(Hongkew) to Pao-Cha 5th Division Office
No.104 Sing Ching Li, Woochang Road.
(3) J.S.680 M.Taniyama (Dixwell Road) to Pao Cha 6th Division
Office, No. 1 Chi Zeu Li, East Jukong Road, Tel.No.02-4417
(4) J.S.799 T.Ishimura (West Hongkew) to Pao-Cha 7th Division
Office, No.40 Louza Ka, North Soochow Road, Tel.No.44474.

I attach herewith a list, for ready reference, showing the
addresses of the Divisional Offices of the Pao-Cha, the names of the
Chief of the Division and the Police Representatives.

Divisional Officer
"C" Division.

重要
“C”分区主管警官备忘录第40号。
“C”分区-分区办事处
1942年5月19日。

致：主管警官 H. WH KR & DR
助理主管警官。

苏州河以北地区的保甲制度及守望队，目前由日本海军陆战队监督和控制。根据已达成的安排，上述当局即将把上述地区保甲制度的监督和控制权移交给上海公共租界工部局。

经上海公共租界工部局和日本海军陆战队批准的市民证，将由保甲分区办事处向居住在其辖区内的居民签发。

本人要求各位巡捕房主管警官将上述制度的行政变更通知各自下属的所有成员，并向所有相关人员强调，为维护治安起见，在此事项上进行密切合作和协助的重要性。请确保所有华籍成员均就此点得到充分指导。

自1942年5月20日起，下列警方代表将被借调至保甲各分区办事处，就与制度运作相关的各项事宜进行指导。

(1) J.S.722 M.Taira，（嘉善路）至保甲第四分区办事处
东余杭路211弄7号。电话 51693
(2) J.S.628 T.Tsuru，（虹口）至保甲第五分区办事处
武昌路新庆里104号。
(3) J.S.680 M.Taniyama（狄思威路）至保甲第六分区
办事处，居恭路东积善里1号，电话 02-4417
(4) J.S.799 T.Ishimura（西虹口）至保甲第七分区
办事处，北苏州路娄家阁40号，电话 44474。

随函附上一份清单，以便随时查阅，列明保甲各分区办事处的地址、分区主任姓名及警方代表姓名。

“C”分区
分区主管警官。

citizens and that they will never conspire with
lawless elements or commit hostile or unlawful acts.

Article 7.- The head (father or mother) of each family is res-
ponsible for the correct filling in of the census
forms issued by the Police. Groups, having no
families, are individually responsible.

Article 8.- In the event of a person who had signed a mutual
guarantee bond becoming involved in unlawful
activities, the others who had signed the same
bond will also be held responsible.

Article 9.- Upon completion of the census, foreign residents
are required to be in possession of CIVILIAN
CERTIFICATES issued by the FOREIGN SECTION of the
Pao Chia Office on application and such certificates
should always be carried on the person (Conditions
governing this certificate will be issued separately)

Article 10.- Changes of address, as well as births and deaths,
should be reported at the Foreign Section of the
Pao Chia Office within one week.

Article 11.- Foreign Hotels, lodging and boarding houses should
submit reports on a special form of the names etc.
of all newcomers as well as the names of all
persons departing from their establishment within
12 hours under the penalty of a fine. These
reports should be gathered at the Police Station
of the district in which the hotels etc. are
located and then forwarded to the Foreign Section
of the Pao Chia Office for necessary entry. The
work of control of all hotels, lodging and boarding
houses are in charge of the respective police
stations of the districts where they are located.

CHAPTER II. - AWARD AND PUNISHMENT

Article 12.-Punishment in accordance with law will be imposed
on persons who commit any of the following
offences and who may be denied sanctuary of the
Settlement in serious cases :-

(a) Aiding, abetting or conspiring with or giving
shelter to undesirable elements or intentionally
withholding information concerning activities
or presence of undesirable elements.
(b) Violating of Pao Chia regulations or refusing
to fill in census forms or giving inaccurate
information in the census.
(c) Neglecting duties allotted to them.
(d) Unnecessarily exercising of authority or
committing corrupt practices.
(e) Disturbing the peace and order.
(f) Promoting any people's movement without permission

Article 13.- Rewards will be issued to persons for performing
any of the following acts :-

(a) Giving information about undesirable elements

-8-
同一地区作为担保，证明他们是真正的
公民，并且绝不会与不法之徒串通或从事
敌对或非法行为。

第七条.- 每户家长（父亲或母亲）负责
正确填写警方发放的人口调查
表。没有家庭的群体，由个人负责。

第八条.- 如果签署联保具结书的人卷入非法
活动，其他签署同一具结书的人也将
承担责任。

第九条.- 人口调查完成后，外籍居民须凭申请
持有由保甲办事处外籍股签发的平民
证，并应随身携带此类证件（有关此
证件的规定将另行发布）

第十条.- 地址变更以及出生和死亡情况，应在
一周内向保甲办事处外籍股报告。

第十一条.- 外国旅馆、寄宿舍和公寓应以专用表格
提交所有新入住者姓名等的报告，以
及所有离开其场所的人员姓名，须在
12小时内提交，违者罚款。这些报告
应汇集于旅馆等所在地区的巡捕房，
然后转送保甲办事处外籍股进行必要
登记。对所有旅馆、寄宿舍和公寓的
管控工作由它们所在地区的各巡捕房
负责。

第二章. - 奖惩

第十二条.- 犯有下列任何罪行的人将依法受到惩
罚，情节严重的，可能被拒绝在租界
内居留：-

(a) 协助、教唆或与不良分子串通，或
为不良分子提供庇护，或故意隐瞒
有关不良分子活动或行踪的信息。
(b) 违反保甲规定，或拒绝填写人口调
查表，或在人口调查中提供不准确
的信息。
(c) 疏忽履行分配给他们的职责。
(d) 不必要地行使职权或从事腐败行为。
(e) 扰乱和平与秩序。
(f) 未经许可鼓动任何民众运动

第十三条.- 对实施下列任何行为的人将给予奖励：-

(a) 提供有关不良分子的信息

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.M.P. REGISTRY
No. 14378

No.50

D.O."C" Office,
July 11, 1942.

The First Anniversary of the Establishment
of the Pao Chia System (Japanese Naval District)

To observe the First Anniversary of the Establishment
of the Pao Chia System (Japanese Naval District) which falls
on the 12/7/42, the following programme will be carried out:-

Commencing at 8 a.m. 12/7/42 about 2000 men will
assemble in the compound of the No.4 Japanese National School
at No.86, Range Road. At 9.30 a.m. 12/7/42 the party will
leave the School compound and proceed along Range Road, Pearen
Road, across Kashing Road Bridge to Dixwell Road, North Szechien
Road, Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters, Kiangwan Road,
where the party will return through North Ssechuen Road, North
Seeshow Road, Whangpoo Road, Woochang Road, North Yangtsze Road
Pearen Road, Seward Road, Boone Road, Woosung Road, Range Road,
and Hannen Road, where the party will disperse.

A police escort party consisting of 2 Japanese Officers
and 6 C.P.Cs will be supplied by Hongkew Station.

Officer i/c and Associate Officer i/c will arrange all
available men attached to their stations to post on important
points where the procession passing along.

“C”分区办事处，
1942年7月11日。

保甲制度（日本海军区）成立一周年

为纪念1942年7月12日到来的保甲制度（日本海军区）
成立一周年，将执行以下计划：-

1942年7月12日上午8时开始，约2000人将在
兰路86号第四日本国民学校院内集合。1942年7月12日
上午9时30分，队伍将离开学校大院，沿兰路、百老汇
路行进，穿过嘉善路桥至狄思威路、北四川路、日本海
军陆战队总部、江湾路，随后队伍将经由北四川路、北
熙华德路、黄浦路、武昌路、北扬子路、百老汇路、西
华德路、蓬路、吴淞路、兰路和汉密登路返回，并在该
处解散。

由虹口巡捕房提供一支由2名日本警官和6名华籍
巡捕组成的警察护卫队。

主管警官及助理主管警官将安排所属巡捕房的所有
可用人员，在游行队伍经过的重要地点布岗。
